_meta.purpose: Per-model documented sampling validity, read by the harness (LOCAL arms map the numeric 'recommended' block onto ollama options; every arm's model_id must be a verbatim key here). A run using sampling a model's provider documents as degrading (e.g. greedy on Qwen3) is treated as config-confounded.
_meta.scope: Public subset: only the five models used by the Jev calibration study v1.

qwen3-14b.note: Qwen3-family models are documented to degrade under greedy decoding, so greedy_ok=false. temperature/top_p/top_k are the Qwen3 card values and hold across quantization. presence_penalty 1.5 comes from the AWQ card and is not confirmed for the GGUF build; the pre-run check (prereg A1/A4.3) measured whether it moves first-token logprobs.

Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B.note: MoE (30B total / 3B active). The official card recommends the sampling above and is silent on greedy decoding; greedy_ok=false is the conservative Qwen3-family default, not a claim the card warns against greedy. ollama maps repetition_penalty to repeat_penalty. Run only when the free-VRAM precondition holds (it did not in v1; see the results).
Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B.source: https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct (verified 2026-09-29: 'We suggest using temperature=0.7, top_p=0.8, top_k=20, repetition_penalty=1.05'; card contains no greedy-decoding warning)

recommended.note: openai/gpt-oss README, Recommended Sampling Parameters: 'We recommend sampling with temperature=1.0 and top_p=1.0.' Mode-agnostic single block; the LOCAL arm reads it as-is.

gpt-oss:20b.note: Reasoning model (harmony format). greedy_ok=false: OpenAI's README recommends temperature=1.0/top_p=1.0 and gives no greedy-ok citation. In v1 the pre-run check found the first generated token is the harmony channel header, so a first-token label read is infeasible and this arm did not run.

claude-opus-5-5.note: Run via `claude -p`. Print mode exposes no temperature control, so sampling is provider-default; the arm logs that as a labelled string rather than a number.
claude-opus-5-5.source: Anthropic (no documented greedy-degradation contraindication; mirrors claude-opus-4-8). claude -p sampling is provider-managed.

jev-1.13.0.note: Hosted structured-decision API. Exposes no caller-settable sampling parameters (temperature/top_p/top_k/seed). Probabilities come from the returned choice/score probabilities or noul (prereg section 2). Measured as non-deterministic (prereg A7).
jev-1.13.0.source: https://docs.typesafe.ai (structured-decision API; no text-generation sampling knobs exposed)
